what_this_can_answer: Which window the account is currently in, when that window resets, and whether the scheduler is still letting sessions start.
what_this_cannot_answer: How much of the window is left. There is no percentage in this source and none must be invented from the status word.
how_it_is_read: scripts/pacing.mjs, and only when state/claude-usage.json reports a window that has already reset. It never overrides a live collector reading.
